areas.narrativeSummary: The school publishes a Vision and Values page as part of its stated ethos [1]. Through sport, children are expected to embed school values alongside fairness, respect and teamwork, developing competence and confidence to collaborate and communicate with peers [2]. The school also states an ambition to ensure appropriate provision for pupils in vulnerable groups and to assess and address the needs of disadvantaged pupils [3].
